A LITTLE DEFINITION. A LOT MORE EASE.

Natural looks different
on everyone.

From delicate hairstrokes to soft shading, your brows should complement your features. You don’t need to choose a technique before you book—we’ll decide together after assessing your skin, existing hair and preferred finish.

01 / SOFT & TEXTURED

Machine hairstrokes

Fine, individually placed strokes create the appearance of brow hairs, with careful attention to direction and flow.

02 / SOFTLY DEFINED

Powder brows

Gentle shading adds a softly filled-in finish. The intensity is tailored to the look you feel comfortable wearing.

03 / TEXTURE & DEFINITION

Combination brows

Hairstrokes and shading work together to bring texture to the front and definition through the body and tail.

IT’S OKAY TO FEEL A LITTLE NERVOUS

You deserve to
feel informed.
And heard.

You’re trusting someone with your face. Your questions, preferences and comfort matter throughout the appointment.

“What if they look too bold?”

We talk about your usual makeup and the finish you want, then plan the shape and colour with you. Fresh brows look stronger than the healed result—we’ll explain that difference before treatment.

“What if the shape doesn’t suit me?”

Your appointment includes a consultation and brow pre-draw. This gives you time to look at the proposed shape, ask questions and discuss adjustments before tattooing begins.

“What if I’m not ready?”

Book a separate consultation first. You can meet Hayley, discuss suitability and see a pre-draw before deciding whether treatment feels right for you.

LET’S TAKE THE GUESSWORK OUT

A few things you might
be wondering.

Do I need to know which technique I want?

No. Book NEW BROWS and Hayley will assess your skin, natural brow hair and preferences with you. The recommendation is personalised. If you’d like advice before committing to treatment, choose a consultation first.

Will my brows look dark straight away?

Fresh pigment can look darker and more defined than the final result. The appearance softens as your skin heals. Hayley will explain what to expect and give you aftercare guidance; healing and pigment retention vary between clients.

Does brow tattooing hurt?

Comfort levels vary. We’ll discuss the procedure and preparation with you, including any numbing arrangements, before your appointment. Please ask us if discomfort is a particular concern.

Will I still need a brow pencil?

You may still choose to use one. Tattooing creates a foundation of shape and definition, while makeup lets you adjust the finish for your day. We’ll talk about how much definition suits you.

Is the touch-up included in $980?

The $980 NEW BROWS price is for the initial session. The separately booked 4–6 week perfection touch-up is $280. Goldie also lists a $1,200 Complete Brows Package. Review the service description and timing conditions when you book.

Can I book if I have an old brow tattoo?

Please book a consultation first. Existing colour, saturation and shape affect what is achievable. Hayley needs to assess your brows before recommending further tattooing or discussing whether lightening should come first.

What should I check before paying a deposit?

Read the selected service description, suitability information and booking policies. Deposits are non-refundable under the listed cancellation policy. If you’re unsure which appointment to choose, email us before booking.
